title: data/text/<jurisdiction>/<edition>/<language>.<source_id>.json
description: One rule-text corpus: the words of one edition of one jurisdiction's rules, in one language, from one source, keyed by paragraph path into data/rules.json. Verbatim unless withheld under a licence bar. See docs/adr/0003-language-as-a-dimension.md, docs/adr/0010-text-withheld-jurisdictions.md and docs/adr/0013-corpus-files-with-editions.md.

allOf.$comment: colregs#85 / ADR 0010: a withheld paragraph is a citation, not a reproduction -- 'retrieved' is when that citation was last checked against the primary source.

id.$comment: <edition>.<language>.<source_id>; CI checks it agrees with the file's path, with data/corpora.json, and that the edition is registered in data/editions.json.

edition.$comment: Edition id from data/editions.json (<jurisdiction>@<tag>): the consolidated state this text reflects -- REQ-LANG-10. The jurisdiction is the edition's, never restated here.

edition_status.$comment: Confidence in the `edition` claim above, not in the text itself: 'verified' means this corpus's edition was checked against the primary source; 'claimed' means asserted but not yet checked (every stub starts here); 'unknown' means even the claim is inherited/guessed. See ADR 0013.

language.$comment: BCP 47. Carries the language of the text and nothing else -- REQ-LANG-1.

source_id.$comment: Short handle for the publishing route (uscg, finlex, boe, ecfr); the identity of the source is the structured `source` object.

tier.$comment: Legal authority of the source, never of the language -- REQ-LANG-3.

normalization.$comment: Unicode normalization form the text is stored in -- REQ-LANG-9.

translation_of.$comment: Corpus id this text is a translation of, where it is one and that is known. Absent for independently promulgated national texts.

source.$comment: REQ-PROV-6: structured source identity, not a prose string.

rights.$comment: REQ-PROV-6: three separate statements, never one flat licence field.

gaps.$comment: Skeleton paths this source could not supply. Distinct from withheld: a gap is text we could not obtain, withheld is text we may not publish.

allOf.$comment: ADR 0010: a withheld paragraph is modelled but ships no text.

else.$comment: mirrors, text_digest and text_slug are open to verbatim paragraphs too; only withheld_reason is incoherent without a bar.

rule_title.$comment: Verbatim source material like `text`; on a withheld paragraph, a neutral label written for this package -- ADR 0010.

text_status.$comment: Absent means verbatim. 'withheld' means the text is not ours to publish -- ADR 0010.

text_slug.$comment: Pencil, ADR 0010: sorted set of lemmatised key nouns and verbs, English counterparts where the source is not English.

text_digest.$comment: Pencil, ADR 0010: algorithm-qualified digest of the normalised text, e.g. 'sha256:<hex>'.

mirrors.$comment: Paragraph path in intl this provision restates; display labelled as the international equivalent, never as this jurisdiction's text.
